visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish hair stands in front of a large white cabinet filled with various colorful collectible figures. She wears a grey t-shirt and denim skirt, gesturing towards her hair and face while looking directly at the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a child's white and black striped shirt featuring a yellow stain highlighted by a red circle and arrow. This is followed by a shot of laundry being tossed into a white plastic basket on a tiled floor. (3) The woman is now in an indoor laundry area, kneeling in front of a silver front-loading washing machine, loading clothes into it with a bottle of blue detergent visible nearby. (4) A young boy in a green shirt sits at a table eating noodles, getting some on his face. (5) On an outdoor balcony with bright daylight, several bottles and refill packs of Ariel laundry detergent are lined up. The woman appears, giving a thumbs up. (6) A side-by-side comparison of fabric is shown with labels. Then, hands are shown scrubbing white cloth in a sink under running water. (7) Returning to the laundry area, the woman puts more clothes into the machine and looks at the camera through the reflection of the glass door. (8) Close-up shots follow of blue liquid being poured from a white bottle into a transparent measuring cap and then into the detergent drawer of a washing machine. (9) A man in a black tank top is seen smelling his clean shirt and flexing his muscles. (10) The woman concludes the video on the balcony, holding a bottle of detergent and gesturing with her fingers while colored confetti graphics appear on screen.
